verdict.rationale: An audit log of cap table changes is a fair question for an equity-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an audit trail or change history recording who changed what, when, and under what authorization. Related items do not qualify: 'board-ready equity governance and reporting', the 'one source of truth' cap table, and admin review of option exercises are adjacent features, not an audit log.

support.subject: As an ops user, every change to the cap table is captured in an audit log — who changed what, when, and under what authorization
